item.title: Mayor Bowser to Cut the Ribbon on Latest Short-Term Family Housing Program, The Triumph in Ward 8
item.description: Monday, November 12, 2018Washington, DC – On Tuesday, November 13, at 4 pm, Mayor Muriel Bowser will cut the ribbon on The Triumph, a short-term family housing program in Ward 8, marking another step forward in delivering on her promise to replace DC General Family Shelter with dignified, service-enriched programs across all eight wards.
